metadata.description: Claude Code mods distributed with these dotfiles

plugins.name: verify-reports
plugins.description: Reminds the main agent to verify reports that other agents deliver before treating them as fact

plugins.name: classify-hint
plugins.description: Classifies the user's prompt with Haiku in one call and attaches a rough, non-binding hint for the main agent

plugins.name: blocker-ask-hint
plugins.description: When the auto mode classifier blocks a tool call, reminds the agent to ask the user for approval instead of giving up on an action the user asked for

plugins.name: japanese-reply-guard
plugins.description: Sends Claude back to rewrite in Japanese when a turn's last reply ends in a line of English
